content: संगम् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To come or join together, meet, encounter; अक्षधूर्तैः समगंसि <ls>Dk.</ls>; एते भगवत्यौ कलिन्दकन्यामन्दाकिन्यौ संगच्छेते <ls>A. R. 7</ls>. .²2 To cohabit, have sexual intercourse with; भार्या च परसंगता <ls>Pt. 1. 238</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 378</ls>. .²3 To keep company or intercourse with, associate with. .²4 To agree, harmonize, be suitable. .²5 To become contracted, shrink up. .²6 To die, depart. .²7 To go to, attain (with <ab>acc.</ab>). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To bring together, join, unite; वधूवरौ संगमयांचकार <ls>R. 7. 20</ls>. .²2 To endow or present with, unite with, bestow on, give to; प्रियसुहृदि विभीषणे संगमय्य श्रियं वैरिणः <ls>R. 12. 104</ls>. .²3 To deliver, hand over. .²4 To kill.
